column1: #   map     use this upstream key for a Mac text that is worded a little differently (a near match)
#   pin     of several upstream keys with this English, use this one
#   reject  don't use this upstream key (or, without a key, any) for the Mac text: the meaning differs on the Mac
#   reject@sl,pt-BR  the same, only in these languages (lproj or upstream code): a pack that gives two different controls
#           of one window the same word (docs/translations.md lists them under "Different texts with the same translation")
# The first column is the Mac's English exactly as in scripts/l10n/mac-keys.json (\n for a line break), or the Mac key
# when it is an identifier (editor.color.line), which then wins over its English. The upstream key is
# module:Section.key, e.g. core:Editor.tornedge_settings or jira:Jira.upload_menu_item. An upstream text with Windows
# wording (Explorer, tray, Ctrl, ...) is refused unless the note starts with "ok:". A trailing hint in parentheses of
# upstream's text ("Draw arrow (A)") is left out of the translation when the Mac text has none.
# Reviewed in wave 5 phase C from the phase B coders' lists and `l10n.py suggest`.
